text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 132 पर भगत सिंह वाला पैराग्राफ़ पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 132 par Bhagat Singh waala paragraph padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the passage about Bhagat Singh on page 132 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: True or false? Bhagat Singh's name echoed all over the country.

questionMeaning.hi: भगत सिंह का नाम पूरे देश में गूँजा।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhagat Singh ka naam poore desh mein goonja.

steps.question: True or false? His name did not inspire the youth in India.

questionMeaning.hi: उनके नाम ने युवाओं को प्रेरित नहीं किया।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Unke naam ne yuvaaon ko prerit nahi kiya.

steps.modelAnswer: False. He became an inspiration for the youth.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। वे युवाओं की प्रेरणा बन गए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Woh yuvaaon ki prerna ban gaye.

steps.question: “Bhagat Singh became a symbol of freedom.” Who said this?
Alphabetical order of: hero, brought, symbol, amazing
A suitable title for the passage:
options: Bhagat Singh: A Symbol of Freedom
steps.answer: Bhagat Singh: A Symbol of Freedom
